app.description: Offline image-token estimates, budget-fit resizing and readable slicing for vision LLM inputs.
help.lang: Output language: en or ko (default: PIXELBUDGET_LANG, then LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG, else en).
help.models: List supported models with source, check date and confidence.
help.estimate: Estimate image tokens per model (reads only the image header).
help.fit: Resize an image to the largest size within a token budget and the provider limits.
help.slice: Cut a long image into overlapping pieces the server will not downscale.
help.report: Report tokens per image and model for files or folders; exit 1 if --max-tokens is exceeded.
help.demo: Run a self-contained demo on a synthetic long screenshot (practice data).
help.paths_size: Image files or folders, or a WxH size such as 1920x1080.
help.detail: Detail level (e.g. low, high, original, medium); default is the model default.
help.out: Output file (default: <name>.fit<ext> next to the input).
help.out_dir: Output folder for the pieces (default: <name>-slices next to the input).
help.dry_run: Only print the plan; write no files.
help.max_tokens: Fail with exit code 1 if any row has more tokens than this.
help.price: Price as MODEL=USD_PER_MILLION_TOKENS (repeatable); adds a cost column.
help.max_pixels: Decode limit in pixels (default: Pillow's MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS).
warn.server_downscaled: The server will downscale this image first.
warn.fixed_per_image: Tokens are fixed per image: resizing does not reduce them.
warn.slice_increases_tokens: Slicing multiplies the fixed per-image tokens: it costs more, not less.
warn.many_images: More than 20 images in one Claude request: stricter per-image size limits apply (about 3000 px per side).
warn.approx_rounding: Approximate: the docs do not fully specify the rounding of the proportional shrink.
warn.approx_rule: Approximate: the documented rule may differ from billed usage.
warn.docs_table_mismatch: The docs table and the docs' reference code disagree for this size; the reference code is used.
warn.decompression_guard: Pixel count is above Pillow's decompression-bomb limit; fit/slice need --max-pixels.
warnings.title: Warnings:
fit.unchanged: No change needed: {w}x{h} already fits ({tokens} tokens). Nothing written.
fit.fixed_per_image: Resizing does not change the cost of {model}: tokens are fixed per image ({tokens}). Nothing written.
fit.suggest: To fit the budget of {budget}, set media_resolution {detail} ({tokens}).
fit.suggest_none: Even the lowest media_resolution is above the budget of {budget}.
slice.summary_one: {n} piece of up to {length}px along the {axis} axis, overlap {overlap}px, {total} tokens in total (whole image: {whole}).
slice.summary: {n} pieces of up to {length}px along the {axis} axis, overlap {overlap}px, {total} tokens in total (whole image: {whole}).
slice.single: The image already fits in one piece; slicing is not needed.
demo.title: pixelbudget demo - synthetic practice data (a generated tall screenshot, not a real capture)
demo.fit: fit: {w}x{h} ({tokens} tokens, scale {scale:.3f}) - small text becomes unreadable
demo.slice: slice: {n} pieces of {pw}x{ph} at scale 1.0 ({total} tokens in total)
demo.tradeoff: Trade-off: slicing costs more tokens but keeps the original text height.
demo.files: Images written to {folder}: fit.png, slice-01.png, compare.png
help.help: Show this help message and exit.
help.strict: Exit with code 1 if any file could not be read as an image.
error.unknown_model: Unknown model {name!r}. Run `pixelbudget models` to list supported models.
error.unknown_model_suggest: Unknown model {name!r}. Did you mean: {suggestions}? Run `pixelbudget models` to list supported models.
error.unsupported_detail: Model {model!r} does not support detail {detail!r} in the model table. Supported: {supported}.
error.invalid_budget: budget must be a positive integer number of tokens, got {budget!r}.
error.budget_below_minimum: budget {budget} is below the minimum of {minimum} tokens for {model} (a 1x1 image already costs that much). Use a larger budget.
error.invalid_overlap: overlap must be a non-negative integer, got {overlap!r}.
error.overlap_too_large: overlap {overlap} must be smaller than the piece length {length} for {model}. Use a smaller overlap.
error.invalid_size_pair: Expected a (width, height) pair of integers, got {size!r}.
error.invalid_size_positive: Width and height must be >= 1, got {w}x{h}.
error.invalid_size_tuple: fit/slice need an image or a path, not a (w, h) tuple; use fit_size/plan_slices.
error.image_too_large: Image is {w}x{h} = {pixels} pixels, above the decode limit of {limit}. Pass max_pixels=<larger value> (CLI: --max-pixels) if you trust this image.
error.no_models: report needs at least one model, e.g. models=['claude-standard'].
error.price_number: --price value must be a number, got {item!r}.
error.unknown_extension: Cannot save {path!r}: unknown image file extension {ext!r}. Use .png, .jpg or .webp.
